rovid.hu: A szorongásos tünetek gyakoriságát méri az elmúlt két hétben.
rovid.ro: Măsoară frecvența simptomelor de anxietate în ultimele două săptămâni.
rovid.en: Measures how often you have had anxiety symptoms over the last two weeks.

forras: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JBW, Löwe B. Arch Intern Med. 2006;166:1092-1097. Forrás és hivatalos fordítások: phqscreeners.com
licenc: A jogtulajdonos (Pfizer) közlése szerint reprodukálásához, fordításához, megjelenítéséhez és terjesztéséhez nem szükséges engedély.
hivatkozas: GAD-7 © Pfizer Inc. Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JBW, Löwe B. Arch Intern Med. 2006;166:1092–1097.

bevezeto.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

kerdesek.en: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

szoveg.hu: A válaszaid alapján az elmúlt két hétben alig voltak szorongásos tüneteid.
szoveg.ro: Pe baza răspunsurilor tale, în ultimele două săptămâni ai avut foarte puține simptome de anxietate.
szoveg.en: Based on your answers, you have had very few anxiety symptoms over the last two weeks.

szoveg.hu: Enyhe szorongásos tünetek jelentek meg. Érdemes figyelni rájuk; ha tartósan fennállnak vagy erősödnek, beszélj szakemberrel.
szoveg.ro: Au apărut simptome ușoare de anxietate. Merită să le urmărești; dacă persistă sau se accentuează, vorbește cu un specialist.
szoveg.en: Mild anxiety symptoms are present. Keep an eye on them; if they persist or get stronger, talk to a professional.

szoveg.hu: A pontszám közepes szintű szorongásra utal. Ebben a tartományban javasolt szakemberrel konzultálni és további vizsgálatot végezni.
szoveg.ro: Scorul indică un nivel moderat de anxietate. În acest interval se recomandă consultarea unui specialist și o evaluare suplimentară.
szoveg.en: The score points to a moderate level of anxiety. In this range it is advisable to consult a professional and have a further assessment.

szoveg.hu: A pontszám súlyos szorongásos tünetekre utal. Javasolt minél hamarabb szakemberhez (pszichológushoz, pszichiáterhez vagy háziorvoshoz) fordulni.
szoveg.ro: Scorul indică simptome severe de anxietate. Se recomandă să te adresezi cât mai curând unui specialist (psiholog, psihiatru sau medic de familie).
szoveg.en: The score indicates severe anxiety symptoms. It is advisable to see a professional (psychologist, psychiatrist or GP) as soon as possible.
